title: When you are asking what this life is for
issueStatement: Life feels busy but unclear, full but underdirected.
centralInsight: Guru frames purpose around meeting, sangat, Naam, and seva rather than around self-invention alone.
practicalReflection: Purpose gets clearer when the question shifts from what will make me feel impressive to what brings me nearer to truth and service.
actionPrompt: Let one decision today answer the question: does this move me toward meeting, service, or only self-expansion?

daily.label: Daily
daily.title: Purpose in the ordinary assignment
daily.issueStatement: Purpose can start sounding like a dramatic calling, so the ordinary duties in front of you begin to feel spiritually small or beneath the question.
daily.centralInsight: Gurbani roots purpose in truthful living before spectacle. Meaning often clarifies inside the next honest duty, not outside it.
daily.practicalReflection: The soul gets lost when it keeps waiting for a larger script. Much of purpose is discovered by showing up truthfully to what has already been placed in your hands.
daily.actionPrompt: Take one ordinary responsibility today and do it as part of your offering, not as an interruption to your real life.

pressure.label: Under Pressure
pressure.title: Purpose when the day tightens
pressure.issueStatement: The day fills up, but the inner reason for being here feels thin. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for first when it feels cornered.
pressure.centralInsight: Guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and Naam rather than mere maintenance. Under strain, the line must interrupt panic before panic defines the moment.
pressure.practicalReflection: Pressure is revealing because it shows which voice the mind trusts when there is no time to decorate itself.

repair.label: After the Slip
repair.title: Purpose after the slip
repair.issueStatement: The day fills up, but the inner reason for being here feels thin. The wound or failure has already happened, and the next task is to return truthfully instead of rehearsing despair.
repair.centralInsight: Guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and Naam rather than mere maintenance. Gurbani keeps repair close to humility, remembrance, and return instead of theatre.
repair.practicalReflection: Repair becomes honest when the mind stops turning failure into identity and lets the next true act matter.
repair.actionPrompt: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Building a life that keeps its purpose
practice.issueStatement: You may glimpse why you are here and still lose the thread a week later because the insight never became a way of living.
practice.centralInsight: Purpose lasts when it is practiced through rhythm, sangat, and truthful work. Gurbani turns meaning from a mood into a pattern.
practice.practicalReflection: A purposeful life is not constantly dramatic. It is structured so remembrance and service keep re-entering before distraction can become the new normal.
practice.actionPrompt: Choose one recurring practice that keeps your life pointed toward seva, remembrance, or truthful labor, and protect it long enough to become recognizable.
